svg.title: Aarav Patel
svg.desc: Synthesised from research patterns; does not represent a single participant.

g.text: Aarav remembers his own first semester and enjoys helping
newcomers. Informal requests can become repetitive and
unpredictable when context and time expectations are missing.
• Choose when and how to provide support
Answers practical questions, shares official links, prefers structured conversations and
Topic context / Availability control / Structured booking / Link Points recognition
